articles.expand: Eurozone inflation accelerated to a three-year high in October on energy prices, reinforcing expectations for another interest rate hike. Inflation increased to 4.0 percent in October from 3.8 percent in September, flash data from Eurostat showed Wednesday.

articles.title: Sweden Central Bank Hikes Key Rate By 25 Bps
articles.expand: Sweden's central bank raised its benchmark interest rate by a quarter-point as inflation is expected to continue rising going forward and hinted at further tightening in the coming year. The Executive Board of Riksbank decided to raise the key policy rate to 2.00 percent from 1.75 percent.

articles.title: Policy rate raised to 2 per cent
articles.expand: Stronger economic activity combined with cost increases due to supply disruptions mean that inflation is expected to continue rising going forward. The Executive Board has therefore decided to raise the policy rate by 0.25 percentage points to 2 per cent. If the outlook for inflation and economic activity holds, it is likely that the policy rate will be raised further in the coming year, in line with the policy rate forecast in September.

articles.title: The Riksbank plans to finance part of the foreign currency reserve with foreign currency loans via the Swedish National Debt Office
articles.expand: To reduce currency risk on its balance sheet, the Riksbank plans to finance the equivalent of around SEK 200 billion of the foreign currency reserve with foreign currency loans via the Swedish National Debt Office. The intention is also to replace the FX swaps that the Riksbank has used for currency hedging since 2023. This change is not intended to affect the long-term size of the foreign currency reserve and does not serve any monetary policy purpose.

articles.title: Australia Hikes Key Rate To 4.85%; Highest Since 2008
articles.expand: The Reserve Bank of Australia raised its benchmark interest rate for the fifth time this year to the highest level in 18 years in order to bring inflation sustainably back to the target. The board, governed by Michele Bullock, voted 6-3 to lift the cash rate target by 25 basis points to 4.85 percent, marking the highest rate since 2008.

articles.title: RBA governor Bullock says it might be that this rate hike might not be enough
articles.expand: In case you missed it, the RBA raised its cash rate by 25 bps to 4.85% today in a less straightforward 6-3 vote. That takes the cash rate to the highest level in 18 years, with the central bank trying not to pre-commit to further tightening at this stage. So far, Bullock's tone in her press conference has been more neutral and even in the latest remarks here. She says that the rate hike today might not be the last one but in trying to make that judgment, "it is not as obvious" as compared to before. articles.title: Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) 25bp rate hike, as widely expected
articles.expand: The Reserve Bank of Australia raised its cash rate by 25 basis points to 4.85% on Tuesday, its fifth increase of 2026 and the highest level since 2008. The board said inflation remains elevated and broadly based, and that staff forecasts have been revised materially higher.
